Export.zv: IRIS for UNIX (Ubuntu Server LTS for ARM64 Containers) 2026.1 (Build 234U)

Property.name: ServiceCache
Property.Description: Avoids constantly reinstantiating the package service objects, which may be expensive.

Property.name: UnavailableNames
Property.Description: Keeps track of which repositories are unavailable (by name - the keys are important, values don't matter)

Method.name: CheckServiceCache
CheckUnpublishEnabled
Unpublish
Method.Implementation:
set tSC = $$$OK
set tClient = ..CheckServiceCache(pRepositoryName,.tAvailable) if 'tAvailable { set tSC = $$$ERROR($$$GeneralError,$$$FormatText("Repository '%1' is unavailable.",pRepositoryName)) quit } $$$ThrowOnError(tClient.Unpublish(pPackageName, pPackageVersion))
return tSC
